title: Sultanahmet Heritage & Taste Journey
summary: A two-day cultural itinerary for a couple in their 30s who love Orhan Pamuk, Sami Yusuf, Ottoman history, calligraphy, coffee and sweets. The trip blends iconic landmarks, museums, cafés and halal food stops around Sultanahmet and nearby Beyoğlu/Galata, with prayer times aligned to local mosques.
tips: Wear comfortable walking shoes; carry a small scarf for mosque visits; try Turkish delight and baklava at recommended sweet spots.

stops.why: The Blue Mosque, an early 17th-century imperial Ottoman mosque famed for its blue İznik tile interior, six minarets, and founder's tomb; suits the couple's interest in Ottoman history and architecture.
stops.name: The Blue Mosque
stops.address: Cankurtaran At Meydanı Cd No:7 34122 Fatih/İstanbul Türkiye
stops.description: Early 17th-century imperial Ottoman mosque famed for its blue İznik tile interior, six minarets, and founder's tomb in Sultanahmet, Istanbul.

stops.why: Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, an iconic Byzantine landmark converted into a grand mosque with ancient mosaics and Ottoman additions; matches their interest in Ottoman history.
